* red follows the winding path as it bends between the trunks, her figure a bright stroke of color in the shadows.
* The basket rests against her hip, light enough to swing, heavy enough to tug her arm in a steady rhythm.
* Her humming threads through the trees, rising and falling as the path climbs small roots and dips into shallow hollows.
* Loose stones crunch and roll aside under her soles, then settle again as the forest closes behind her.
* Shafts of light cross her face and hood as she passes, painting quick stripes of brightness on the red cloth.
* A jay falls silent on a high branch as she approaches, tilts its head, then flies deeper into the gloom.
* From somewhere off the path, unseen by red, a wolf matches his pace to her sound, keeping to the darker thickets.
